name: 1980s Tokyo alley neon

prompt.existence: The logo exists as a hand-bent glass neon sign, its shapes traced faithfully in glowing tube
prompt.material: Real neon tubing with visible electrodes and mounting frame against a rain-darkened brick wall
prompt.environment: A narrow 1980s Tokyo back alley at night, wet asphalt reflecting the sign
prompt.light: The neon is the key light; deep shadows, subtle cyan spill from a distant vending machine
prompt.camera: 35mm photograph, eye level, shallow depth of field
prompt.contextWrap: The sign belongs to a business in this field: {context}

notesJa: ネオン管はロゴの線を管に置き換える解釈が入るため、細部より輪郭の再現性を評価する。ワードマークは短い単語ほど成功しやすい。
